_comment: THE PUBLIC HALF of the owner's catalogue. Committed to a PUBLIC repo.
Three things read this file: the Projects section on site/index.html, the
demo catalogue in site/static/demo-api.js, and scripts/seed-projects.py,
which writes into the real links catalogue when the stack is up.
EVERY ENTRY HERE IS public:true, AND THAT IS NOW STRUCTURAL.
Private entries live in site/projects.local.json, which is GITIGNORED.
Split on 2026-09-28 for a specific reason: `public:false` decides where an
entry may APPEAR, and it never decided whether the URL gets COMMITTED.
Two links carried an account id and an org id in their paths, and this
repository is public, so the flag was protecting the page while the
repository published the URL anyway. Neither id is a credential, but a
public commit is permanent.
So the rule is now mechanical rather than remembered: if it is not
public:true, it does not belong in this file.
category decides which column an entry appears under on the dashboard.
gateway's app.js groups by it -- one section with its own heading per
category, sorted alphabetically. Four in use as of 2026-09-28: projects,
infra, productivity, media. A fifth needs nothing but a new string.
Blurbs are quoted or condensed from each project's own README rather than
invented, so they stay true if someone follows the source link.

projects.name: gymlog
projects.blurb: Single-user installable PWA for logging resistance training and daily food intake — and for seeing whether any of it is working.

projects.name: Procedo Infosystems
projects.blurb: Marketing site for an infrastructure-first IT firm — IT infrastructure, security, audio-visual, telecom and power systems.
projects.note: Moved from netlify.app to Cloudflare Pages 2026-09-20; the old procedoinfo-preview.netlify.app now returns 404, so the previous value was a dead link on the public page. Still a preview subdomain -- if it moves to the client own domain, change it here, this file is the only place it is written.

projects.name: Acharya Amit Puri
projects.blurb: Practice site for a Vastu, Vedic astrology and numerology consultant. Near-zero JavaScript, edited from a single config file.
projects.note: Repo is acharya-amit-puri, not -pur; the shorter name only works because GitHub redirects. Deployed to Cloudflare Pages 2026-09-20, which is when public flipped to true -- it had been false only because the URL was a localhost dev server on 4322 (not Astro's default 4321, so it can run beside Procedo). That dev server still works locally; this file now points at the deployed site, because this URL is served to visitors.
